description: This file defines the interface for rbusObject, a reference-counted handle to a named collection of properties in the rbus API. It includes function declarations for creating, managing, comparing, and accessing properties and values within rbus objects, as well as related data types and enums.

classes.name: rbusObject
classes.description: A handle to an rbus object, which is a reference-counted, named collection of properties.

methods.name: rbusObject_Init
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new rbus object, optionally assigning a name.

methods.name: rbusObject_Retain
methods.description: Increases the reference count of an rbus object to share ownership.

methods.name: rbusObject_Release
methods.description: Decreases the reference count and releases ownership of an rbus object.

methods.name: rbusObject_Compare
methods.description: Compares two rbus objects for equality, optionally recursively.
